verses.en: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.pt: Vinde, cantemos alegremente ao Senhor, cantemos com júbilo à rocha da nossa salvação.
verses.en_web: Oh come, let’s sing to Yahweh. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!
verses.en_bbe: O come, let us make songs to the Lord; sending up glad voices to the Rock of our salvation.

verses.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.pt: Apresentemo-nos diante dele com ações de graças, e celebremo-lo com salmos de louvor.
verses.en_web: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
verses.en_bbe: Let us come before his face with praises; and make melody with holy songs.

verses.en: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
verses.pt: Porque o Senhor é Deus grande, e Rei grande acima de todos os deuses.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all gods.

verses.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.pt: Nas suas mãos estão as profundezas da terra, e as alturas dos montes são suas.
verses.en_web: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.
verses.en_bbe: The deep places of the earth are in his hand; and the tops of the mountains are his.

verses.en: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.pt: Seu é o mar, pois ele o fez, e as suas mãos formaram a serra terra seca.
verses.en_web: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
verses.en_bbe: The sea is his, and he made it; and the dry land was formed by his hands.

verses.en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
verses.pt: Oh, vinde, adoremos e prostremo-nos; ajoelhemos diante do Senhor, que nos criou.
verses.en_web: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
verses.en_bbe: O come, let us give worship, falling down on our knees before the Lord our Maker.

verses.en: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.pt: Porque ele é o nosso Deus, e nós povo do seu pasto e ovelhas que ele conduz. Oxalá que hoje ouvísseis a sua voz:
verses.en_web: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
verses.en_bbe: For he is our God; and we are the people to whom he gives food, and the sheep of his flock. Today, if you would only give ear to his voice!

verses.en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.pt: Não endureçais o vosso coração como em Meribá, como no dia de Massá no deserto,
verses.en_web: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
verses.en_bbe: Let not your hearts be hard, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the waste land;

verses.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.pt: quando vossos pais me tentaram, me provaram e viram a minha obra.
verses.en_web: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.
verses.en_bbe: When your fathers put me to the test and saw my power and my work.

verses.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.pt: Durante quarenta anos estive irritado com aquela geração, e disse: É um povo que erra de coração, e não conhece os meus caminhos;
verses.en_web: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways.”
verses.en_bbe: For forty years I was angry with this generation, and said, They are a people whose hearts are turned away from me, for they have no knowledge of my ways;

verses.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.pt: por isso jurei na minha ira: Eles não entrarão no meu descanso.
verses.en_web: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”
verses.en_bbe: And I made an oath in my wrath, that they might not come into my place of rest.
